name: focus_place_double_plant
about: Right-click the west face of a double tall grass (lower half at (8, 64, 36)) with a stone block. Both send the same C08 (clicked position and face). 1.8.9 treats the plant as replaceable and predicts the stone in place at (8, 64, 36); 1.7.10 only replaces snow, vine, tallgrass and deadbush in place, so it predicts the stone at (7, 64, 36). The next frames' pick shows which.
